name: corecashier
description: CoreCashier — an offline-first tablet till for Iraqi shops, in Arabic, Kurdish and English.

scripts.build:pos: vite build --config vite.pos.config.ts && node scripts/build-portable-pos.mjs dist-pos pos-portable.html CoreCashier.html
scripts.build:demo: vite build --config vite.demo.config.ts && node scripts/build-portable-pos.mjs dist-demo demo-portable.html CoreCashier_Demo.html
scripts.build:loaner: vite build --config vite.loaner.config.ts && node scripts/build-portable-pos.mjs dist-loaner loaner-portable.html CoreCashier_Loaner.html
scripts.build:cloud: vite build --config vite.cloud.config.ts && node scripts/build-portable-pos.mjs dist-cloud cloud-portable.html CoreCashier_Cloud.html
scripts.build:check: vite build --config vite.check.config.ts && node scripts/build-portable-pos.mjs dist-check check-portable.html CoreOS_Device_Check.html
scripts.build:check-app: vite build --config vite.checkapp.config.ts && node scripts/build-app.mjs dist-check-app check-index.html devicecheck
scripts.build:keys: vite build --config vite.keymaker.config.ts && node scripts/build-portable-pos.mjs dist-keys keymaker-portable.html CoreOS_Key_Maker.html
scripts.build:gen: vite build --config vite.generator.config.ts && node scripts/build-portable-pos.mjs dist-gen generator-portable.html CoreCashier_Code_Generator.html
scripts.build:ceo: vite build --config vite.ceo.config.ts && node scripts/build-portable-pos.mjs dist-ceo ceo-portable.html CoreCashier_Owner_Console.html
scripts.build:all: npm run build:pos && npm run build:demo && npm run build:loaner && npm run build:cloud && npm run build:check && npm run build:keys && npm run build:gen && npm run build:ceo
